name: Crash and Error Reporting Foundation
scope: Define provider-neutral structured crash and nonfatal error records with data minimization
Add bounded local buffering, deduplication, retry policy, and safe offline behavior
Separate development diagnostics from any future consent-aware production transport
Add deterministic serialization, failure isolation, and retention-policy tests
outOfScope: Installing or activating a production crash-reporting SDK
Collecting identifiers, save payloads, credentials, purchases, or unrestricted logs
Network upload without legal, consent, regional, provider, and security approval
Production Android signing, AAB generation, Play publishing, or package-lock activation
Claiming closed/player-facing transactional save durability before copy-on-write gameplay mutation transactions are implemented
entryCriteria: v1.17 Step 2 compiles in Unity 6000.5.9f1 with retained zero-error evidence
The Step 2 project validator and Editor self-test pass with retained output
Complete Step 2 EditMode and PlayMode XML is retained with zero failures, skips, or inconclusive tests
Disposable-profile migration, corruption, backup, future-version, reset, offline, suspend/resume, and forced-termination checks pass
Save failure diagnostics are stable and contain no raw payload or sensitive value
